faqs.question: How long does a typical SEO engagement take?
faqs.answer: Technical and on-page foundations usually take 4–8 weeks. Meaningful organic growth compounds over 3–6+ months of consistent execution.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We plug into your CMS, analytics, Search Console, and content workflows, and we collaborate with in-house marketers or founders.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: Non-branded growth, conversions from organic, rankings for revenue terms, Core Web Vitals, and content ROI — reported monthly.

faqs.question: Do you do technical SEO and content?
faqs.answer: Yes. Audits, crawl health, schema, internal linking, page templates, and an editorial roadmap tied to commercial intent.

faqs.question: Ecommerce SEO too?
faqs.answer: Yes — collection/product architecture, facet strategy, duplicate control, and content that supports category demand.

faqs.question: How do you avoid risky shortcuts?
faqs.answer: No PBNs, no fake engagement schemes. We build durable authority with useful content, technical excellence, and ethical link earning.

faqs.question: Will you rewrite our site copy?
faqs.answer: Where it moves rankings and conversions. We prioritize high-impact templates and money pages before long-tail sprawl.

faqs.question: Local SEO included?
faqs.answer: When relevant: Google Business Profile, location pages, citations hygiene, and review strategy aligned to your markets.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: We run a technical + content opportunity audit, then propose a 90-day sprint with clear owners and KPIs.

faqs.question: Who executes month to month?
faqs.answer: An SEO lead with content and engineering support as needed; you approve priorities in a simple monthly cadence.
